BharatInnovates2026

 14 June 2026

iDEX and its Startups/MSMEs participated at BharatInnovates2026. Three iDEX winners marked major milestones through strategic partnerships and investment commitments. EyeROV secured a $5 million commitment from Unicorn India Ventures Fund III; CYRAN AI signed an MoU with Safran for AI-led Industry 4.0 transformation; and Crimson Energy Experts partnered with IIT Hyderabad and Dassault Systèmes to establish CODENE. These collaborations strengthen India’s deep-tech ecosystem, accelerate technology development and advance Aatmanirbhar Bharat.

DISC 14 & ADITI 4 Launch

 19 March 2026

At the National Defence Industries Conclave 2026, Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh launched DISC-14 and ADITI Challenges 4.0 under iDEX, unveiling 107 problem statements—82 under DISC-14 and 25 under ADITI 4.0—from the Defence Forces, Indian Coast Guard and Defence Space Agency. A new initiative featuring 101 innovation challenges from DPSUs was also launched by Raksha Mantri to encourage design-led innovation by MSMEs and start-ups.

National Defence Industries Conclave 2026

 19 March 2026

National Defence Industries Conclave 2026, held at Manekshaw Centre, New Delhi, under the theme “Advanced Manufacturing Technologies.” The conclave presented key perspectives on the growth of India’s defence manufacturing capabilities and highlighted the crucial role of MSMEs in driving self-reliance.

Roundtable with Banks, Financial Institutions, Investors, Startups and MSMEs

 16 April 2025

Secretary (DP) Shri Sanjeev Kumar chaired a Roundtable with banks, financial institutions, investors, startups and MSMEs on April 16, 2025, at South Block, New Delhi. The discussions focused on financing risks, challenges, and aligning funding mechanisms with the needs of iDEX startups and defence innovation.
